name: MileIQ
summary: MileIQ tracks drives automatically and sends them to a reporting dashboard for teams. Its Teams Pro plan includes custom rates, and approval and reminders with automatic reporting. The business pricing page lists Teams Lite at $8 a user a month, Teams at $9 and Teams Pro at $10, billed monthly, with no currency named.

facts.text: The MileIQ home page says the app tracks mileage automatically, so the user does not have to stop and log a drive.
The business pricing page lists automatic trip tracking on Teams Lite, Teams and Teams Pro.
The business pricing page says Teams Pro includes custom rates. The page does not say whether IRS rates are applied.
The business pricing page says Teams Pro includes a reporting dashboard, approve and reject, and reminders with automatic reporting.

plans.name: Teams Lite
plans.unit: per user per month, monthly billing
plans.notes: $80 per user a year on annual billing. Report submission and review are included.

plans.name: Teams
plans.unit: per user per month, monthly billing
plans.notes: $90 per user a year on annual billing. Adds a reporting dashboard.

plans.name: Teams Pro
plans.unit: per user per month, monthly billing
plans.notes: $100 per user a year on annual billing. Adds custom rates, approve and reject, and reminders. The monthly option has a free trial with no card required.

hiddenCosts: The page names no currency. The figures are recorded with the dollar sign as shown.
